name: Store facade
purpose: The single module that opens the underlying engine, holds the connection or file handle for the process lifetime, runs the migration runner at open, and exposes narrow named verbs to consumer code. Consumers never import the engine binding directly; the facade is the one place the engine choice lives.
responsibilities: Open the underlying engine against a configured store identifier (path or connection string), set the crash-safety posture the engine needs for kill-9 tolerance, and hold the handle exclusively for the process lifetime (AC-5101-1, AC-5101-2, AC-5105-3).

Invoke the migration runner (TAC-602) at open, propagating its outcome to the caller: refuse-newer errors and migration-failed errors are thrown up unwrapped or wrapped with the original code preserved (AC-5101-3, AC-5103-1, AC-5109-2).
Expose a schemaVersion read operation whose return value equals the highest applied migration version recorded in the bookkeeping table (AC-5102-2).
Expose the domain CRUD verbs as named exports with typed parameters; refuse a general-purpose raw-query passthrough on the public surface (AC-5107-2).

Emit structured events (opened, migrated, backupCheckpoint, closed) on the injected onEvent sink; carry only store-metadata fields; never carry values read from domain rows (AC-5106-1, AC-5106-3, AC-5110-1).
internalStructure: One module that exports an openStore({ path, onEvent }) entry point returning a facade object whose methods are the named CRUD verbs plus schemaVersion, backup, and close. The engine binding import is scoped to this module; the migration runner (TAC-602) is imported here and invoked before the facade returns. Consumers destructure the verbs they need at their top level and hold the facade reference for the process lifetime.

interfaces.name: openStore
interfaces.description: openStore({ path, onEvent }) -> Store; the sole entry point the boot sequence calls. Returns a Store facade with the migration runner already run and the crash-safety posture already set.

interfaces.name: onEvent
interfaces.description: Structured-event sink invoked with { event, ts, ... } for opened, migrated, backupCheckpoint, and closed events. Never invoked with domain-row values.

interfaces.name: store.verbs
interfaces.description: The named domain CRUD verbs the facade exposes. Each verb has typed parameters; no verb accepts a raw query string or engine-native query object from consumer code.

dependencies.name: Migration runner
dependencies.description: Invoked at open with the loaded migration catalog and the open engine handle; its result feeds the opened/migrated events.

dependencies.name: Migration catalog
dependencies.description: Loaded at open and handed to the migration runner. The catalog's max version anchors the schemaVersion contract.

dependencies.name: Backup runner
dependencies.description: Exposed as store.backup(outputPath); emits the backupCheckpoint event on completion through the same event sink.

tradeoffs: The facade owns the engine handle for the process lifetime; consumer code cannot pool or share handles across the boundary. That cost buys the one-boundary invariant every other AC on this blueprint depends on. Projects that need a per-request connection pool (a shape more natural to Postgres than to SQLite) wire the pool inside this module and preserve the facade's outward interface unchanged.
